verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a client-side iOS terminal app, and its official repo documents that users can download, build and install Blink themselves through Xcode (gh-2, gh-4). A community member confirms it can be compiled for free (comm-9), so the core product can run fully under the user's own control, independent of the vendor's App Store distribution. This is build-from-source and sideloading rather than self-hosting a service in the server sense, and the self-build path is only thinly documented. missing for 10: detailed self-build/deployment documentation, clarity on which features (if any) depend on vendor-hosted services, independent hands-on reports of running a self-built copy long-term.
